title: Free the Soldier
description: The camp holds one live prisoner, not two. You will find what's left of Toma Idle before you find Wex. Clear the bandits and get the corporal out while there is still a corporal to get out.

objectives.description: Kill the captors who took the patrol
Kill the Bandit Captain holding him
Get Corporal Wex Bramwell out alive

notes: Toma Idle's death is prose-only - no objective marks it, since the file already commits to one hostage. This is the too-late beat of the rescue: half the patrol is beyond saving before the player sets out.
